statement: Relational Database Service (RDS) provides managed relational databases with MySQL, PostgreSQL or Microsoft SQL Server (Standard and Enterprise Edition), with tools for automated deployment, maintenance, monitoring, backup and recovery. Each engine runs as a single instance or as a synchronous primary/standby (HA) pair with optional read replicas, and MySQL and PostgreSQL come in general purpose and dedicated flavors. The documentation describes automated backups in a one-hour time window on the days of the backup cycle (every day by default), kept for a retention period of 1 to 732 days (default 7) for all three engines. The Regions and Endpoints page lists API endpoints for RDS in eu-de and eu-nl.

statement: Software can be installed on a Windows ECS from an ISO held in OBS: the ISO is pulled into the guest with rclone, mounted with the PowerShell cmdlet Mount-DiskImage -PassThru, installed from the mounted drive letter and released with Dismount-DiskImage.

source: vendor license manager on a test instance
statement: LiDAR360 from GreenValley uses a node-locked license key with online activation through its License Manager. The key binds to the machine, and moving it requires a return or deactivation on the old machine before activation on the new one.

source: live RDP test against an ECS on a test tenant, eu-de
statement: On Windows Server 2025 an ECS that is reachable only over RDP cannot complete a forced first-logon password change. The server requires NLA by default and the client stops with error 0x1207, password must be changed before logging on.

the instance had neither WinRM nor console access, so the OS could not be reached another way

source: documentation mirror: IMS
statement: A restored Windows server brings its data disk up Offline because of the SAN policy OfflineShared. Setting san policy=OnlineAll before the full-ECS image is created fixes this once in the image instead of at each restore.

statement: Client Windows images such as Windows 10 and Windows 7 may only be used to create ECS on a Dedicated Host. The service description additionally limits bring-your-own Microsoft Windows and SQL Server licences to Physical and Dedicated Hosts.
